_readme: Hand-edited inputs for scripts/build_data.py: content that is a judgment or a game rule, not data read from the .md files.
Values here are merged into KS_DATA as-is. A key that the .md parser also produces is an error (the build fails).
Field meanings: docs/SCHEMA.md. Keys starting with '_' are ignored.

rules.drillCamp: Slotted heroes auto-level to the lowest of the 5 instructors' levels (in-game text, 22 and 25 Oct) and use no XP. Level Resets set a hero to Lv 1 and refund all their Hero XP (in-game text, 22 and 25 Oct). A hero removed from Drill Camp returns to its own level (community sources).
rules.oneMarchPerHero: A hero can be in only one march at a time.

skillBooks.text: Skill book counts (a/b on a skill's Upgrade button) are your shared stock of that book type, not progress saved on that skill. Each rarity has its own books: Epic heroes share Epic books, Mythic heroes share Mythic books, so books spent on one Epic hero are gone for every other Epic hero. Book type names are read from the icons.

redeemShards.text: The Redeem count on a hero's promotion screen is a shared stock of shards per rarity: Epic heroes share Epic Redeem shards, Mythic heroes share Mythic ones, so shards redeemed for one hero are gone for the others of that rarity. How many hero shards one Redeem shard gives is not recorded.

recommendations.what: Promotions: Edwin is 1 Rare shard from Tier 4 now; keep the 27 Epic Redeem shards for Diana's 4★ (needs 45); Jabel is 19 shards from Tier 5
recommendations.why: Redeem shards are a shared stock per rarity (confirmed by you on 27 Oct). You spent 25 Epic Redeem shards on Yeonwoo's 3★ (52 → 27, 27 Oct), which also lifted her Lv. 3 skill cap, including On Guard, her rally-joiner skill. The 27 left cover only one Epic promotion: Fahd's 3★ (needs 19; 21 / 40 on 27 Oct), but Fahd is in no line-up. Diana needs 45 for 4★ (55 / 100), Quinn 47 for 4★ Tier 1 (53 / 100), Chenko 73, Howard 76, Gordon 78. Diana stays the next Epic target: her promotion is the bigger step (+37,360 base power and +6.38% Archer Attack and Defense, against Quinn's +32,560 and +6.31%), and 4★ lifts her Lv. 4 cap on Iron Constitution (−18% → −20% stamina cost in the Be march she leads). Rare: Edwin is 1 shard from Tier 4 (39 / 40; +17,940 base power and +2.90% Cavalry Attack and Defense), so 1 of the 2 Rare Redeem shards promotes him now; Seth needs 9 for Tier 5 (31 / 40; +18,785 base power). Neither is in a combat lineup. Mythic: Jabel needs 19 for Tier 5 (21 / 40, Redeem 2 on 27 Oct); Helga needs 5 (0 / 5 on 22 Oct) and Saul 15 for Tier 5 (0 / 15 on 27 Oct), both in no lineup.
steps: Edwin → promotion screen: Redeem 1 Rare shard (39 / 40 on 27 Oct), then Ascend to Tier 4.

recommendations.what: Troops: train Infantry next; your army is 32% Infantry, fewer than the 50% Infantry most guides use for attacks and rallies
recommendations.why: Your 105,729 Tier VII troops are split almost evenly: Infantry 34,151 (32.3%), Cavalry 36,438 (34.5%), Archers 35,140 (33.2%) on 24 Oct. Community guides most often give 50% Infantry / 20% Cavalry / 30% Archers for attacks and rallies, and about 60 / 20 / 20 for city defense, because Infantry is the front line that takes the hits. A full march holds 79,275, so 50% would be 39,638 Infantry: 5,487 more than you own. Your Att preset is 41% / 33% / 26%. Until more Infantry is trained, the closest you can get is all 34,151 Infantry (43%), 23,783 Archers (30%) and 21,341 Cavalry (27%).

recommendations.why: Community guides agree that a march joining someone else's rally adds only one skill to it: the first (top) expedition skill of its lead hero. Chenko's top expedition skill is Stand of Arms, +15% Lethality for all squads (Lv. 3), and she leads no march today. Yeonwoo's On Guard gives the same +15% Lethality and, since her 3★ promotion on 27 Oct, can also go to Lv. 4; Amane's Tri-Phalanx (+15% Attack) stays capped until her 3★. Terror is rally-only, and you have a fourth march queue (4 / 4) with three presets saved.

recommendations.what: Skill books: next 50 Epic Conquest Books to Gordon's Trash Talk, next 50 Epic Expedition Manuals to Howard's Joint Defense
recommendations.why: Skill books are a shared stock per type, so each 50 books buys one Lv. 3 → 4 upgrade for one hero. The ranking puts first the skills that help every troop or hero (not just the hero himself) on heroes used in the most line-ups. Conquest Books upgrade march (expedition) skills: the first pick, Howard's Defenders' Edge (all troops take 16% less damage), reached Lv. 4 by 27 Oct, so Gordon's Trash Talk is next: it raises every squad's Attack from 15% to 20% in the Be march and Barricade 2. Expedition Manuals upgrade Arena (exploration) skills: Howard is in the front of both Arena squads, and Joint Defense raises Defense for all heroes from 10% to 12.5%. The cheaper Lv. 2 → 3 upgrades (30 books) on Amane and Saul are not ranked first because neither is in a combat march or Arena squad. If you join other players' rallies more than you lead, Chenko's Stand of Arms (her rally-joiner skill) goes before Trash Talk: see the rally suggestion.

recommendations.what: Long term: Mythic shards and books to Jabel first; Epic investment to Howard, Quinn and Diana, plus Chenko or Yeonwoo as the rally joiner; Helga and Saul last for combat
recommendations.why: Jabel is your only Mythic hero in the combat line-ups (Att, both Arena squads, Barricade 1), and community guides call her the easiest Generation 1 Mythic to build without paying; she is 19 shards from Tier 5. Guides rank Amadeus as the strongest Generation 1 hero, but he is not recruited (0 / 20) and they say he mostly comes from paid packs. Guides call Helga pay-to-win and rank Saul lowest of the Generation 1 Mythics in combat; Saul's value to you is Resourceful (now Lv. 3: +9% construction speed, −9% cost). Among your Epic heroes, a 2026 list rates Howard and Quinn highest and Diana for beast hunting. Guides also say Generation 2 heroes (Zoe infantry, Hilde cavalry, Marlin archer) arrive around kingdom day 37–50 and Generation 3 around day 105–120; one guide advises building Jabel until Generation 3 rally heroes arrive.
steps: Mythic shards: Jabel to Tier 5 (21 / 40, needs 19) before Helga (0 / 5) or Saul (0 / 15).
Mythic books: Jabel's Youthful Rage and Persistence (see the skill-book suggestion), not Saul's.
Amadeus: collect his shards from free events when offered (0 / 20 on 22 Oct); buying him only makes sense if you plan to spend.
Epic shards and books: Diana, Quinn and Howard first, then the rally joiner (Chenko or Yeonwoo); Fahd and Amane are in no combat line-up.
Tell us your kingdom's age in days (or whether Zoe, Hilde or Marlin have appeared) so the Generation 2 timing can be checked.
evidence: hero.md promotion screens of 27 Oct: Jabel 21 / 40 to Tier 5; Helga 0 / 5; Saul 0 / 15; Amadeus 0 / 20 to recruit (22 Oct)

Community server timelines (kingshotmastery.com, kingshotoptimizer.com): Gen 2 around day 37–50, Gen 3 around day 105–120
recommendations.note: Verified: your shard counts and line-ups. Unverified: all rankings and the Generation 2 / 3 timing come from community guides (some from 2025) that disagree with each other; check your kingdom's in-game event calendar.

recommendations.what: Test a combat hero instead of Forrest in the Be (beast) march
recommendations.why: Forrest's two expedition skills only help wood (Woodland Inheritor: sawmill output; Master Woodcutter: wood gathering), so they do nothing in a beast fight. Diana (lead: -18% stamina, +60% hunting march speed) and Gordon (+15% squad Attack and Health) stay. Helga is the closest swap: she is also infantry, so the troop mix stays the same, and she adds Echoes of Valhalla (+10% squad Attack) and Oath of Guardian (16% chance to halve damage taken). Her hero power is lower (259,615 vs Forrest's 371,073), so test it before keeping it.

steps: Deploy → Be → remove Forrest → add Helga → Save.
Hit the same beast level you use now and compare troop losses with an earlier hunt.
Keep whichever loses fewer troops.
